description: Official Replicate API schema for bytedance/seedream-5-pro

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation. Maximum 4000 characters. BytePlus recommends keeping prompts under 600 English words for best results.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input image(s) for image-to-image generation. List of 1-10 reference images for single or multi-reference generation.

aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio. Use 'match_input_image' to automatically match the input image's aspect ratio.
